note: Gold set. Every row carries origin, label_source, data_mode and slice. Labels are at DOCUMENT level: acceptable_documents names the source document(s) that contain the answer, and a hit is a retrieved procedure belonging to one of them. The split is a fixed-seed hash of the row id, not a PRNG, so adding a row never re-splits the others.
owner_wording_note: The OD- rows are owner-directed drafts: topics chosen by the owner, wording drafted by Claude. They are NOT real customer questions and must never be described as such.
